data.text: Onboarding discovery 2026-10-12: on a fresh journal the prompt hook is silent exactly when it would matter most. With one decision ('Postgres, not MongoDB', rejected 'MongoDB: …') the prompt 'should we move orders to MongoDB?' returns nothing from hook prompt and nothing from search; only the bare word 'MongoDB' matches. It starts answering at five decisions. Likely the rarity weighting: on a corpus of one, every word is equally common. A first-run 'aha' built on one hand-written decision would show silence; one built on imported ADRs would work.
